_note: Page title 'USCIS | Fee Waiver'. SECOND page on I-485 (on the I-765 this was third, after client-information) - order here is select-eligibility -> able-to-pay -> client-information. Radio defaults to 'Yes' (pre-checked). Same generic MUI name 'controlled-radio-buttons-group' as the Six-and-Six radio on page 01, so anchor by question text. Choosing 'No' reveals the Form I-912 fee-waiver upload inline - see branch-able-to-pay-no.json. next-btn is enabled on arrival because 'Yes' is already selected.
